component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Metanode to create input data for interactive Volcano plot using Volcano plot application in Python. Volcano plot application needs to be located e.g. in KNIME workspace, please check the path in the metanode settings (default is "gitfolders/KNIME_metanodes/Applications/Volcano_plot/" folder inside your KNIME workspace).
You have to provide data columns for p-value and log fold change. Rows with missing value in any of these two columns are removed. P-value column is -log10 transformed prior plotting. In Case of p-value=0, the minimal value in the given dataset is used for the zero value replacement prior -log10 transformation or it is possible specify the replacement value in the application.
You can also specify other columns for annotations.
Dataset is exported by the metanode into the Volcano plot application ("data/knime_data" subfolder). The metanode then starts the simple python webserver inside the Volcano plot application folder and opens browser with the interactive Volcano plot application.
The metanode will be shown as still running to indicate that the webserver is running from that concrete metanode. You can cancel the metanode or close the workflow with the running metanode to stop the webserver.
The application contains form for setting input data of appliacation, interactive Volcano plot itself, summary table showing the number of rows passing the selected thresholds of logFC and p-value, table of selected proteins from graph and table with dataset, which could be filtered - the Volcano plot shows only the data passing the filters used in the last table (no filter set by default, i.e. showing all rows).
